cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Module 1 teaches you to read a packet, a subnet and a Linux or Windows box like an attacker: ports and services, CIDR math, HTTP, and drills reused later in privilege escalation.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Know ports by heart: 21 FTP, 22 SSH, 23 Telnet, 25 SMTP, 53 DNS, 80/443 HTTP(S), 110/143 POP3/IMAP, 139/445 SMB, 3306 MySQL, 3389 RDP, 5985 WinRM. Drills: ss -tulpn for listening ports, find / -perm -4000 for SUID binaries, curl -v for raw HTTP.

questions.q: Which ports do SMB and RDP use?

questions.a: SUID binaries, reused later for privilege escalation.
What is listening locally and which process owns it.
